brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Pieces at level 0 (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) and level 1 (piece:0,0,1;full, piece:1,0,1;full) with snap connectors between storeys
Two notch drawer frames: notch:0#0,1#notch1 at level 0 and notch:1#0,1#notch1 at level 1

Full bins on top cells (bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full, bin:1,0,1~hex-bin-full) provide open storage, plus two large drawer compartments per level; dressed with small hardware props; capped faces and lockJoints applied

finish.summary: Built a 2-wide x1-deep x2-high tower with a drawer on each storey and topped bins for workbench storage. Caps and joint bolts applied, mesh clear.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
